function.name: create_workbook
function.description: Create an in-memory openpyxl workbook. Returns workbook_id (use it for all subsequent calls). Optional theme is applied to shells/components when not overridden.

function.name: save_workbook
function.description: Save the workbook to demo/excel/. Path must resolve under demo/excel/.

function.name: get_workbook_info
function.description: Return live workbook metadata: sheets, row/col counts, charts, tables.

function.name: verify_workbook
function.description: Re-open a saved .xlsx and report structural verification: sheet list, rows/cols, charts, tables, warnings (empty sheets, etc).

function.name: execute_xlsx_code
function.description: Run arbitrary openpyxl code against the live workbook. Pre-injected names: wb, Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side, BarChart, LineChart, PieChart, ScatterChart, AreaChart, Reference, ColorScaleRule, CellIsRule, FormulaRule, IconSetRule, DataBarRule, Table, TableStyleInfo, get_column_letter, column_index_from_string, copy_style, token(kind, name).

from_skill_ids.description: JSON/comma list of inspected wiki skill ids adapted by this code.

target_node.description: Sheet/block/role target, or JSON/comma list for multiple grounded sections.

adaptation_notes.description: Short note describing the concrete mechanisms borrowed from the skills.

function.name: list_tokens
function.description: List token names under a given kind directory.

function.name: get_palette_preset
function.description: Return a theme palette JSON (header_bg, header_fg, accent, etc).

function.name: get_format_preset
function.description: Return a number-format preset JSON (e.g. currency_usd, percent_signed, kpi_traffic).

function.name: get_chart_template
function.description: Return a chart template JSON (chart_type, style, axis fonts, gridlines, default size).

function.name: get_formula_snippet
function.description: Return a formula pattern JSON with {placeholders}.

function.name: apply_component
function.description: Apply a tier-3 component (KPI strip, header band, summary row, themed chart, etc.) at a cell anchor on a worksheet.

kwargs_json.description: JSON-encoded kwargs for the component's render(ws, anchor, **kw) function

function.name: add_sheet_from_shell
function.description: Add a tier-4 sheet shell (full sheet skeleton: title + data + chart + table) to the workbook.

function.name: init_from_archetype
function.description: Build a multi-sheet workbook from a tier-5 archetype (e.g. quarterly_report, financial_model).

function.name: list_skills
function.description: Browse the skill library. Filter by tier (token|component|sheet_shell|archetype), category, or theme.

function.name: get_skill_info
function.description: Return full metadata for a skill (description, applicability, parameters).

function.name: get_skill_code
function.description: Return the .py source of a tier-3/4/5 skill so the agent can read technique and replicate.

function.name: search_skills
function.description: Search wiki skills by task keywords, optionally filtered by tier or category_path.

function.name: get_skill_visual
function.description: Return the visual reference path for a wiki skill and attach it to the model when available.

function.name: apply_skill
function.description: Apply a wiki T3/T4/T5 skill to a workbook target through the domain capability matrix.
